messages:
Aisha (CS): Heads-up — prepping ACME QBR next Tue. Need a short runway + spend snapshot focused on token econ, and any onboarding gaps that could affect renewal. Can someone own the numbers?
Ben (FinOps): I can run the spend snapshot. Quick ask: do we want burn by model + embedding vs chat tokens?
Aisha (CS): Yes please split embed vs chat. Embeds spiked after last activation. Also include 30/60/90 day runway and alert thresholds.
Carlos (Solutions): FYI we rolled a prompt optimization last week; should shave ~15% token usage on gen routes. I'll share the rollout timestamp so Ben can segment pre/post.
Ben (FinOps): Perfect — send the timestamp. I'll produce a one-pager with: current MRR, monthly token burn, 30/60/90 runway at current pace, and a scenario with Carlos's optimization applied.
Dani (PM): Adding: customer reported latency issues during onboarding which might've led to repeated retries (inflated tokens). Captured in feedback doc: https://redwood.example/notes/acme-onboard-ops (share for context).
Aisha (CS): @Ben include any credits/retainer buffers and any upcoming usage forecasts from their SRE team. Also surface renewal risk if runway < 60 days.
Ben (FinOps): Copy. Will surface a small mitigation playbook: throttle profiles + suggested quota alerts. Quick check: do we present the playbook in QBR or as pre-read?
Aisha (CS): Put the numbers in the QBR deck and link the playbook as an appendix. Keep the deck client-facing and the detailed playbook internal.
Carlos (Solutions): Rollout timestamp: 1712490000. Also sending a short A/B prompt comparison snippet in thread.
Ben (FinOps): Got it. Beginning calc now. Preliminary numbers by EOD.
qbr-bot: Reminder: QBR template deadline in 48h — upload to /drive/QBRs/ACME.
Aisha (CS): Thanks — I'll gather customer success notes and enablement asks. If Ben posts the draft, I'll add the risk narrative. 
Ben (FinOps): Draft uploaded: /drive/QBRs/ACME/draft-spend-snapshot.pdf — includes pre/post optimization scenarios and alert thresholds.
Dani (PM): I'll review for accuracy and add the latency/retry note to the appendix.
Aisha (CS): Great. Last ask: flag any surprise one-offs (data migrations, test bursts) so we don't over-index on short spikes.
Carlos (Solutions): I'll annotate the spike on 1712455000 — that was a batch migration test, not production.
Ben (FinOps): Noted — removing that from baseline. Final slide set to be ready by tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
Aisha (CS): Awesome team, thanks. I'll run a quick rehearsal before the QBR.
